chunks: Lowered will be their eyes, disgrace overwhelming them. They had indeed been called to bow in homage when they were free of blame.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'disgrace overwhelming them' in Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the irony of those who neglected the physical act of prostration (sujood) in worldly life, only to be commanded to do so on the Day of Judgment when they are physically incapacitated by disgrace. The phrase 'while they were healthy' (salamoon) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring to their freedom from disease and death, emphasizing that the opportunity for sincere worship was lost during their period of ease and capability.
